title: 第27章：大队长
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“江彩霞，你说真的，你看见了？”

    江彩霞冷哼一声，“那小兔崽子昨天就在家做肉，这是我亲眼所见，这还能是假的。”

    “啥？昨天就吃肉了？”

    “他家哪来的钱买肉？”

    “就是，马建业受伤治病的钱还是跟我借的。”

    “说的我好像没借似的，老子家里都没钱吃肉，他家还吃上肉了。”

    周围的议论声就更大了，全是义愤填膺的表情。

    毕竟这年头每家都不富裕，吃肉就更好比过年一样，听见马家不仅有肉吃，还有细粮，不少人眼睛都红了。

    “要我说，就该让马建业把欠大家伙的钱还了，欠债还钱天经地义，他家有钱买细粮，买肉吃，却没钱给大家伙还钱，哪有这样道理。”

    “大家伙说是不是？”

    “说得对，必须要他们家还钱。”

    “还钱，还钱！”

    “找大队长去。”

    也不知道人群里谁吼了一句，众人齐刷刷朝着大队长家走去。

    江彩霞看见众人离开的背影，心里头那叫一个高兴，“小兔崽子，敢跟老娘斗，看老娘整不死你们。”

    ……
content_en:
"Jiang Caixia, are you serious? Did you see it?"

    Jiang Caixia snorted coldly, "That little brat was cooking meat at home yesterday. I saw it with my own eyes. Can it be fake?"

    "What? Did you eat meat yesterday?"

    "Where does his family get the money to buy meat?"

    "That's right, the money for Ma Jianye's injury and treatment was borrowed from me."

    "It's like I didn't borrow it. My family doesn't have money to eat meat, but his family still has meat."

    The discussion around them became even louder, all filled with expressions of indignation.

    After all, every family is not rich these days, so it is better to eat meat than during the Chinese New Year. Many people's eyes turned red when they heard that the Ma family not only had meat to eat, but also fine grains.

    "If you ask me, Ma Jianye should be allowed to repay the money he owes the big guy. It is natural to pay back debts. His family has money to buy fine grains and meat, but they have no money to repay the big guy. How can it make sense."

    "Didn't the big guy say so?"

    "You're right, they must pay back the money."

    "Pay back the money, pay back the money!"

    "Go to the captain."

    I don't know who in the crowd yelled, and everyone walked towards the captain's house in unison.

    When Jiang Caixia saw the people leaving, she felt happy in her heart, "You little bastards, if you dare to fight with me, let's see if I can kill you."

    …
